description: RACI matrix builder — Build a RACI responsibility matrix for a project: give project= (description) and optionally roles= (comma list) and tasks= (separated by ; or |). AI drafts the assignments, then offline rules enforce exactly one Accountable and at least one Responsible per task, report each role's load, warn about bottlenecks, idle roles and over-consulting, and return Markdown and CSV tables. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).

project.description: e.g. Launch a customer self-service billing portal for our SaaS product
